$comment: PER-MACHINE workspace configuration. Copy to .agent/workspace.json (gitignored) and edit.
products_root — where the products/ mount point lands on THIS machine.
Omit the key entirely to use the in-repo default <repo>/products.
Overridden per-shell by the AGENTIC_PRODUCTS_ROOT environment variable.
A configured root that does not exist is an ERROR, not a fallback.
products/_root/ is PINNED to the repo and never moves with the mount.
sitecore_orgs — the Sitecore orgs this machine works against. The label is what you pass as --org and the suffix of your
credential keys (SITECORE_CM_CLIENT_ID_<LABEL>). orgName and tenant are what a minted token must name: copy them from the
token's org_name and tenant_name claims. Empty or absent, assert-tenant.mjs refuses every org unless the caller names the
production_org — a regex (case-insensitive) over the org as a manifest spells it. A match shows the run as PRODUCTION.
Absent or invalid, every named org shows as production: the wrong warning beats none.
default_org, default_cm — optional defaults for check-template-base-chain.mjs. Absent, it requires --org and --cm.

acme.tenant: <tenant_name claim of your CM client's token>
